# SecNote

> One-time, end-to-end encrypted notes. The client encrypts with AES-256-GCM, the server keeps only the ciphertext, in RAM, and deletes a note on its first read. No accounts; creating and reading a note need an Argon2id proof of work.

Use it to hand over a password, API key or token as a one-time link instead of pasting the secret into a chat, ticket or e-mail.

## For agents

- [REST API](index.md): endpoints, proof of work, share link format, errors
- [Agent skill](/.well-known/agent-skills/create-encrypted-note/SKILL.md): create and read a note step by step, with Python code
- [API catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of this instance
